title: bundle, engine: a pre-gate ending decide could never take is refused at compile, gpt-flash's pre-gate security-hold stops, and the 0109a2 follow-ups (#1221, #1212)
body:
Refs #1221, #1212. The 0109a2 follow-ups, story unit 1221a:
- the compiler refuses a unanimous-pass panel under the residual pair;
- it refuses a protected sequence's pre-gate ending the engine could never take;
- decide takes gpt-flash's pre-gate `security-hold` as the stop that 0050 and 0109 rule;
- a select case's sequence sees `change`;
- the residual names have one home, and the guide's poison sentence is corrected.

**On main.** #1216 (0109a1) merged as 335935931, and #1222 (0109a2) as d64fdecfc. This branch was restacked onto main d64fdecfc (head 4f343ba26), so this diff is the unit's alone. On main: workspace clippy `-D warnings` is clean and runtime lib passes 2,456.
- abef9e65b (1a) and 0557ccda3 drop out, because main carries 1a as b35c9fd2d and its tests in `verdict/stop_tests.rs`.
- ea997d460's gpt-flash hunk drops for the same reason (now fde34fef5).
- 62231b782 gives main's new sequence test constructors `declares_change`.

Brokkr-Run: story-unit-1221a-round-2-1221a2--4e389ea7
Ruling: #1088 (https://github.com/feedback-loop-ai/brokkr/issues/1088#issuecomment-6960606249), operator 2026-11-17, "accept 0109 as recommended": decision 0109 accepted with its 13 rulings as recommended; this PR carries 0109a2's follow-ups (#1221) and #1212's L1.
Ruling: #1221 (https://github.com/feedback-loop-ai/brokkr/issues/1221#issuecomment-7057813015), operator standing ruling 2026-11-04, "go with recommended on anything else that comes up" and "and by hand". It covers:
- L1's option (c): 1a, decide takes a compiled pre-gate hard stop; and 1b, the compiler refuses a pre-gate ending decide could not take;
- items A, C, E, F and G, each as recommended;
- the controller's by-hand fix of the review's LOW 1, in 706416f27;
- the public API growth: brokkr-runtime +15 lines (`BodyRefusal` with `PreGateEnding`, `PreGateUndeclared` and `UnanimousPassUnderResidual` and their fields; `CompileError::Body` on both paths; `SequenceStep::declares_change` on both paths).

It lands with the `by-hand` label, because the controller fixed LOW 1 after the run's anchored head (ea997d460).

**Draft until CI is green on 4f343ba26.**

## What it builds

**#1212 L1, taken as (c)** (#1221 c-7057813015). The shipped `recipes/gpt-flash` protects `review`, and every case there is [positions, a work-class review panel; chief, the gate]. A position's `security-hold` parked the run where 0050 rulings 5 and 7 say it stops.
- **1a, engine:** on main via #1216 (b35c9fd2d), so not in this diff after the restack.
  - decide takes a work step's compiled hard word before every gate as a stop, on no head;
  - it still refuses a latched malformed record, and reconciles the attempt's records against the stop's position;
  - ship is never requested, and no reviewed head is recorded.
- **1b, compile** (70c42f6dc and 706416f27). In the protected phase, a sequence step before the first gate may end only on a hard word the seat declares:
  - a word that does not stop the run is refused (`PreGateEnding`);
  - a stop the seat's results do not declare is refused (`PreGateUndeclared`), since decide refuses a word outside the seat's results before it reads the stop.

**#1221's items:**
- **A** (9730cce57): a unanimous-pass panel under a seat that declares the residual pair is refused at compile, wherever the panel stands (`UnanimousPassUnderResidual`), rather than at every pass.
- **C** (3f95bdd4a): a seat whose body and input set are both refused reports the body's refusal first, as before 0109a2.
- **E** (9fe6f5c2d): a sequence reads whether its seat declares `change` from its compiled steps (`SequenceStep::declares_change`), so a select case's sequence sees it as a plain seat's does.
- **F** (f6c08db77): the residual claims read the pair's names from `findings::ResidualInput`.
- **G** (50791c09d): the recipe-authoring guide says a non-final step's poisoned aggregate, or a refused gate word, fails the attempt and is never handed on.
- **Tests:** 3defb62ac, 0557ccda3 and ea997d460, with no new clone.

Left on #1221: B (the lanes' library handoff), D (the wrap width) and the SC2016 note.

## Review

Round 1 stopped IMPL-BLOCKED with items 2 to 6 built. L1's premise was wrong: gpt-flash's protected review does end pre-gate on `security-hold`. Round 2 (1221a2) built 1a and 1b.

Its panel was:
- DeepSeek Flash, adversarial;
- Claude Opus 5.5, correctness;
- DeepSeek Flash, correctness.

The Claude Opus 5.5 chief ruled REVIEW-REFORGE-EXHAUSTED-DEBT: residual, max `low`, no security residual and no specification defect. The chief's own read confirmed 1a's rule end to end: Unlawful still refuses first, and the stop's inputs carry no head. It also confirmed that 1b runs only in the protected phase and recurses into select cases.

**The surviving findings:**
- **LOW 1, fixed by hand in 706416f27:** the hard-word exemption admitted a stop the seat does not declare, which decide then refuses (`__schema-invalid__`). It failed closed, and no shipped recipe hits it.
- **LOW 2, kept:** the "before every gate" geometry is spelled in two places, `Producer::step` and `refuse_pre_gate_ending`. Both are test-bound, the hard-word fact has one home (the compiled `hard_results`), and the commission asked for no refactor beside 1a. Recommended: a follow-up that gives the geometry one home.
- **INFO:**
  - `checked_head`'s `Producer::Stop` arm is reachable only from tests. Exhaustiveness forces it, and it refuses.
  - `PreGateEnding` and `PreGateUndeclared` don't name the select case.
  - The `"change"` literals in bundle/entry.rs and decide.rs:~277 remain, per round 1's follow-up.
- **A run defect, not a finding on the change:** the Opus correctness position ran `cargo build` and the compile loop from the worktree, not from its scratch. That breaks the read-only rule for review positions. Only the gitignored `target/` was touched, and `git status` was clean.

## Asks

None of the operator's. **Taken as recommended under the standing ruling:**
- 1a's stop decides on no head: no `reviewed_heads` and no `fixes_docs_only`.
- `engine/tests.rs::a_sequence_fences_a_malformed_change_before_the_dialect_tool_runs` now sets the compiled step flag (item E).
- 1b's unprotected control test uses a [work, impassable gate, work] shape. That is the smallest shape that can be built, because a two-step body's pre-gate `ends_on` holds only hard words.
- LOW 1's fix and its +4 API lines.
- **The restack (done, 62231b782):** abef9e65b and its two gpt-flash tests dropped, since #1216 carries them. On the restacked tree:
  - fmt and workspace clippy;
  - core lib 436;
  - runtime lib 2,448 of 2,449. The one failure was a cool-down test flake under load, which passed three times alone;
  - typos, and the files, clones and api ratchets.

## Checked by the controller

- **The host's exact coverage at ea997d460** (the run's head): lines, branches and functions all 100% (102,618 lines, 12,586 branches, 13,692 functions). The host lints, including the api ratchet, pass, and the evidence is published.
- **The core mutants gate** (`scripts/mutants.sh gate 7c969aa5d brokkr-core`, for f6c08db77): 7 mutants, 6 caught, 1 unviable, 0 missed.
- **706416f27** (LOW 1, by hand):
  - runtime lib 2,397 tests;
  - workspace clippy `--all-targets --all-features -D warnings`;
  - typos, and the files, clones and api ratchets;
  - the removal control, run and restored: the test fails with the declared check dropped.
  - CI's exact coverage measures it.
- **12 commits, every one signed.**
